results.title: Rohit Saraf on Undergoing 15-Months of Physical Transformation for The Revolutionaries: I was active, I was fit, but I was definitely not Brad Pitt from Fight Club
results.description: Rohit Saraf is making the right noise with his recently released period drama series, The Revolutionaries, which sees him step into the shoes of a freedom fighter, Sachindranath Sanyal. And now, the actor opened up about undergoing rigorous physical training for 15 months for the role, aligning with director Nikkhil Advani’s vision for his portrayal. “Primarily, my preparation was physical.
